account_selector: Exactly one confirmed active nonbanned account matching the owner's existing recovery form. Email is supplied privately in chat; no plus-address alias equivalence.
purpose: A bounded application acceptance window for recovery save/verification/session tests; no signup-link browser-approval prerequisite is asserted for this established recovery account.
privilege_and_fences: postgres current/session user, privileged origin, original advisory transaction lock, fixed project, matching retained current catalog, canonical bounded session_valid source/metadata/ACL checks, installed controller reviewed-hook checks on opening

state_handling.QUARANTINED: Use installed open_acceptance_window with the one selected account for 1800 seconds.
state_handling.ACTIVE_exact_same_unexpired_account: Reuse the existing deadline without any control-row or window write.
state_handling.ACTIVE_other_or_multiple_unexpired_accou: Refuse; retain their window and deadline.
state_handling.ACTIVE_expired_valid_bounded_window: Call original quarantine(), then original open_acceptance_window, atomically; later failures roll both transitions back.
state_handling.unknown_or_malformed_or_drifted_state: Refuse and roll back; do not repair catalogs or synthesize a window.

only_writes: Installed controllers update existing private rollout/window rows. A transaction-local safe result setting is used. No DDL, function/policy changes or direct application/proof writes.
safe_receipt: Result enum, transition enum, one-account count, duration bound, expiry timestamp and fixed booleans. No email, UUID, token, code, password or private catalog hash is returned.
owner_preconditions: New staging deployment URL received after successful local two-to-three recipient preparation; explicitly confirm that the prepared recipient secret was saved in both staging environments before this deployment.
Select the named staging project independently before SQL. Keep the existing genuine recovery form open; do not refresh it or reuse the consumed original link.
Return safe SQL result before submitting matching passwords or requesting a gateway email code. If SQL errors, stop and return the fixed error.
public_readback_limitation: Automated new-deployment/canonical requests were blocked. No new source parity, live secret equality, mailbox delivery or hosted acceptance is credited.
subsequent_case: Continue existing AU04.05 save-failure/retry and security/session outcome scope after readiness; no AU acceptance cases added.
local_model_limitation: Actual candidate and installed-controller source run in offline PGlite with modeled Auth/control/catalog state. This does not prove current hosted catalog, actual Auth recovery session, provider delivery, or production behavior.
